youtube_metadata.title: NVIDIA Launches Platform to Stop Rogue AI Agents #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
NVIDIA just launched the Open Agent Safety Platform, combining OpenShell software sandboxing with out-of-band BlueField-4 DPU monitoring to contain autonomous AI agents.
